description: This file defines the user interface layout for a preferences dialog in a Qt application, generated from a .ui file using Qt Designer's code generator. It contains the layout and widgets for configuring project settings, observation parameters, plugin management, FFmpeg framework paths, spectrogram settings, plot colors, and interface options.

classes.name: Ui_prefDialog
classes.description: Class that sets up and manages the user interface elements for the preferences dialog window.

methods.name: setupUi(self, prefDialog)
methods.description: Initializes and arranges all widgets and layouts within the preferences dialog.

methods.name: retranslateUi(self, prefDialog)
methods.description: Applies the translated strings to UI elements for localization.
